item.title: Earthquake reported in Alleghany County Friday afternoon
item.description: SPARTA, N.C. (WGHP) — A small earthquake hit just outside of Sparta Friday afternoon, according to North Carolina Emergency Management. A 2.0 magnitude earthquake was reported at around 12:15 p.m. According to NCEM, it is also Earthquake Awareness Month. In the event of an earthquake, remember to drop, cover and hold on.
